title: ARSIA MiFID II Audit Record
description: MiFID II audit record for asset transfers involving EU-regulated entities or MIFID-II compliance profile. Generated for every qualifying AssetTransferRequest per ARSIA-Assets.md §6.1. Contains financial-specific fields — transaction amounts, provider references, settlement timestamps, and human oversight status — that extend the base audit concept for MiFID II Article 16(7) record-keeping. Records are immutable and retained for minimum 1827 days (5 years) per §6.1.2.

audit_id.description: Unique identifier for this audit record (UUID v4). Per ARSIA-Assets.md §6.1.1.

message_id.description: The id of the AssetTransferRequest message (UUID v4). Per ARSIA-Assets.md §6.1.1.

receipt_message_id.description: The id of the AssetTransferReceipt message (UUID v4). OPTIONAL — absent if the receipt has not yet been generated. Per ARSIA-Assets.md §6.1.1.

amount.description: The requested transfer amount. Per ARSIA-Assets.md §6.1.1.

actual_amount.description: The actual amount processed. OPTIONAL — absent if the transfer has not yet completed. Per ARSIA-Assets.md §6.1.1.

currency_or_unit.description: The currency code or unit identifier. Per ARSIA-Assets.md §6.1.1.

asset_type.description: The asset type enum value. Per ARSIA-Assets.md §6.1.1, §2.

payment_reference.description: The unique payment reference. Per ARSIA-Assets.md §6.1.1.

provider_reference.description: The external provider's transaction ID. OPTIONAL — absent if the provider has not yet responded. Per ARSIA-Assets.md §6.1.1.

initiated_at.description: When the transfer was initiated at the provider. Per ARSIA-Assets.md §6.1.1.

settled_at.description: When the transfer was settled. OPTIONAL — absent if not yet settled. Per ARSIA-Assets.md §6.1.1.

failure_reason.description: The reason for failure. OPTIONAL — present only when status is 'failed'. Per ARSIA-Assets.md §6.1.1.

compliance_profile.description: The compliance profile applied to this transfer. Per ARSIA-Assets.md §6.1.1.

allOf.description: The data residency zone (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 or supranational identifier). OPTIONAL. Per ARSIA-Assets.md §6.1.1.

SHA-256 hash (lowercase hex) of the payload from the originating message. When security.encrypted is false or absent: SHA-256(RFC8785(payload)). When security.encrypted is true: SHA-256(UTF-8(JWE string)). Verifiable without decryption keys. Per ARSIA-Assets.md §6.1.1 and ARSIA-Core.md §5.3.1.

SHA-256 hash (lowercase hex) of the RFC 8785 canonicalized plaintext payload. Present ONLY when the originating message has security.encrypted=true. Enables dispute resolution over encrypted content. MUST NOT be present when security.encrypted is false or absent. See ARSIA-Core.md §5.3.1.

human_oversight_status.description: Whether human oversight was triggered and its outcome. Per ARSIA-Assets.md §6.1.1.

approver_id.description: The agent-id of the agent that approved the transfer. OPTIONAL — present only when oversight was required and approval was granted. Per ARSIA-Assets.md §6.1.1.

approval_timestamp.description: When the approval was granted. OPTIONAL — present only when approver_id is present. Per ARSIA-Assets.md §6.1.1.

exemption_reason.description: SCA exemption justification. Present when the transfer was exempt from Strong Customer Authentication per ARSIA-Assets.md §6.3. Per ARSIA-Assets.md §6.1.1.

created_at.description: When this audit record was created. Per ARSIA-Assets.md §6.1.1.

updated_at.description: When this audit record was last updated. Updated when the receipt is received. Per ARSIA-Assets.md §6.1.1.
